intent: Phase 7, third: write the per-Body progression snapshot, so an agent's recorded growth survives the deletion of the events it was derived from. Warrant WG-ARCH-003 (C for the per-Body progression record) and ADR-0004. Progression is currently recomputed from raw history, so pruning that history would silently change past levels. Source row WO-0010. Ordered strictly BEFORE T-0017, and the operator merges this task because it is data safety. Acceptance: (1) one immutable row per agent profile carrying level, achievements, the inputs digest and versions; (2) corrections land as new rows, never edits; (3) it lands BEFORE T-0017's prune. Done when an agent's recorded growth survives the deletion of the events it was derived from. Tier proposal R2, matching the declared facts: migrates-schema is declared because a new table and a numbered migration are added. Per the plan's section 12, the acceptance oracle is authored before implementation by a session that has not seen the implementation.
